general_guidelines: Strictly follow the Dark Theme. Avoid light theme entirely unless explicitly toggled, but optimize for Dark Mode.
Do not use generic 'SaaS Blue' or 'AI Purple'. Rely on deep black with stark white text and neon accents.
Use generous padding. E.g., cards should have p-6 or p-8.
Apply 1px borders to all containers to simulate a 'Technical/Grid' look.
Never center text blindly. Use optical alignment and prioritize left-aligned data streams.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.

numbers_and_data.usage: Use for all balances, transaction amounts, and chart labels.

layouts.dashboard_grid: Bento Grid Protocol Mode B (High Density). Base: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Gap: gap-4 or gap-6.
layouts.spacing: Use p-6 or p-8 for inner card padding. Separate major sections with py-12.
layouts.header: Crystal Glassmorphism variant: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl backdrop-saturate-150 border-b border-white/10

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or completely sharp (rounded-none). Primary CTAs are bg-white text-black hover:bg-zinc-200 transition-colors. No generic blue buttons.
components.cards: Flat background (bg-[#0A0A0A]), 1px border (border-white/10), no heavy drop shadows. On hover, translate-y-[-2px] and subtle border glow.
components.inputs: Shadcn components heavily customized. bg-transparent border-white/10 text-white focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#00FF9D]. No Vercel default look.
components.toast: Use Sonner. Dark mode variant with border-white/10 and neon accent lines for success/error.
components.receipt_upload: Dashed border area (border-white/20 border-dashed) with hover state turning border-[#00FF9D]. Include micro-animation for upload.

data_visualization.pie_chart: Monochrome or High-Contrast Neon lines. No solid fills-use stroke (strokeWidth 2) for an 'x-ray' technical feel, or strict flat colors without gradients.
data_visualization.bar_chart: Brutalist bars. bg-white/20 base, bg-white on hover. Sharp edges (no rounded corners).
data_visualization.line_chart: Main stroke color: #00FF9D. Area gradient: from-[#00FF9D]/20 to-transparent. strokeWidth: 2.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Only for headers/navs. bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-2xl border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.textures: Overlay a fixed subtle noise texture (opacity-5) across the entire background to kill 'digital flatness'.
visual_enhancers.animations: Framer motion for staggered list entrance. Micro-animations on hover (scale 1.02 for cards).

receipt_placeholder.description: Paper receipt on dark table, used for OCR mock/preview

user_avatar.description: Neon-lit user portrait for profile avatar

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts from Google Fonts: Cabinet Grotesk (or substitute with Clash Display/Outfit), JetBrains Mono, Manrope.
Install lucide-react or @phosphor-icons/react for premium icons.
Strictly avoid #7351B7 (purple gradients) and #1B93A4 (teal). Use the specific neon accents defined (#00FF9D, #FF3366).
Implement a noise overlay over the main background layout for texture.
Use grid lines (border-white/10) extensively in the dashboard to create a technical 'Bento' look.
Ensure all numbers (balances, amounts) use JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums enabled to prevent layout shifting.
Do NOT center align the app container. Maintain strict left-alignment for data lists.
Add data-testid attributes to all form inputs, buttons, and transaction rows for robust testing.
Create new components matching the dark, high-contrast, technical style of the customized Shadcn primitives.
Use js files and jsx files. Do not generate TypeScript (.tsx/.ts) code.
Implement Sonner toast notifications exclusively for success, error, and OCR feedback states.
